name: Fey Dragon Scale
summary: Around Stonetalon Peak, faerie dragons give up scales that Jin'Zil covets. The Darkspear witch doctor uses one in a brew meant to mock night elven nature magic.

sections.title: A Rare Forest Harvest
sections.body: Faerie dragons haunt the wild groves around Stonetalon Peak. Their scales shine with natural magic. Night elves honor them as harmless woodland spirits and allies. Outsiders prize the scales as rare magical ingredients.

sections.title: A Mocking Concoction
sections.body: At Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil mixes a brew to mock kaldorei traditions. He combines a fey dragon scale with tree sap, feline whiskers, and dozens upon dozens of courser eyes. He calls the result 'forest magic.' The cruel concoction is meant for the three night elves he keeps caged.

faq.q: Where does this scale come from?
aliases: where to find fey dragon scale
faq.answer: Faerie dragons in the highland groves around Stonetalon Peak yield the scale, including Wily Fey Dragons and Nal'taszar.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil want a fey dragon scale?
aliases: what is the scale used for
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin wants the scale along with other woodland reagents. He sneeringly calls his brew 'forest magic' and means it for his caged night elf prisoners.

faq.q: What happens when Jin'Zil finishes his brew?
aliases: what does jin'zil do with the brew
faq.answer: Jin'Zil plans to use the finished brew on his three captive night elves. When he carries out that plan, the fate of his prisoners is revealed.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know faerie dragons as treasured companions and forest guardians of the kaldorei. Seeing their scales taken for a troll witch doctor's deadly mockery is an outrage to nature.
As a member of the Horde, you help Jin'Zil secure the Horde's footing in the Stonetalon Mountains and strike at the night elven presence higher on the slopes.
